name: Live simulation trace
purpose: A system runs on one seeded event list: a gauge with a cell stack, an event log, a step chart with event ticks and a regime caption swapped in place all read the same state.

inputs.name: events
inputs.description: [{t, kind take|refill, amount}], e.g. from Studio.comp.simulationScript(seed, phases)

implementation.api: Studio.comp.simulation(parent, data, {logRows, chartHeight}) -> {enter, run(tl, at, {duration}), exit, states}; Studio.comp.simulationScript(seed, phases) -> events

layout_notes: Grid: gauge and log on top, chart filling the middle row, regime caption under it; give the parent a height.

validation.evidence: Runtime checks tests/studio-runtime/explain-devices.html (63 checks incl. seek-order independence) in Playwright Chromium on Windows, 2026-11-28; golden scene tests/reference-derived/explain-simulation-race/index.html frame review 0 errors 0 warnings and contact sheet inspected. Not rendered through HyperFrames on the M2, so not approved.
